execution.independent_review: Independent hand-derived fixtures and separate exported-artifact validation code; no claim of a separate reviewer or external scientific validation.

hashes_before_after.after_map_semantics: All 574 files independently rehashed after export and exactly equal to this immutable map; reference is intentional normalization, not an uncomputed assumption.

artifact_counts.verification_binding_note: This verification binds the export manifest and post-export independent validator. The export manifest predates that validator and binds the four implementation/pre-export fixture files. No self-referential verification hash is asserted.

sizes_bytes.interpretation: All profiles together exceed the old approximately 99MiB asset. Delivery is intentionally indexed/sharded: load 325075-byte index and one at-most-359473-byte company, not the combined 149696834 bytes. No app loader changed here.

coverage.meaning: Input coverage, not target support, predictive performance, legal debt completeness or financial-health validation.
